# Cyberlounge Portfolio

> Personal portfolio (cyberlounge.net) for Nicholas Perry: an anime and gaming "quest log notebook" showing the apps and sites he builds, with a Cal.com booking link. Built on Next.js 15 App Router.

## Project Overview

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 15.5.18, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 3, Lenis
**Status:** Active (quest-log redesign, ADR-007, built 2026-10-25)
**Purpose:** Show current apps and sites in Nicholas's own voice, and route people to a Cal.com call

## Core Documentation

- `README.md`: setup and getting started
- `CODE_MAP.md`: feature-to-file map (current)
- `docs/ai/memory.md`: project history, current state, project roster (current)
- `docs/ai/decisions.md`: architecture decisions; ADR-007 is the current design, ADR-002/003/005/006 are superseded
- `docs/ai/roadmap.md`, `docs/ai/tasks.md`: forward-looking priorities and tech debt (written before the redesign)
- `docs/ai/architecture.md`: system design and design tokens (current)
- `ENTRY_POINTS.md`, `DATA_FLOW.md`, `FEATURE_BOUNDARIES.md`, `IMPORT_GRAPH_SUMMARY.md`: entry points, data movement, responsibilities, coupling (current)
- `docs/plans/2026-05-19-architect-redesign-*.md`: historical plans for the superseded Architect design

## Key Files by Area

### Site shell
- `src/app/layout.tsx`: root layout, fonts (Dela Gothic One display, DotGothic16 pixel, Zen Kaku Gothic New body), metadata, Navbar/Footer mount, graph-paper body
- `src/components/Navbar.tsx`: pixel-font nav (QUESTS / QUEST LOG / PLAYER / CONTACT) with a ▶ cursor on the active route and a MENU/CLOSE mobile menu
- `src/components/Footer.tsx`: black strip with external links
- `src/components/SmoothScroll.tsx`: Lenis smooth scroll
- `src/app/globals.css`: color tokens (`--background`, `--ink`, `--muted`, `--body`, `--rule`, `--grid`, `--surface`, `--accent`, `--cleared`) and manga utilities (`.paper`, `.tone`, `.speed`, `.panel`), plus the View Transitions wipe
- `tailwind.config.ts`: theme colors mirroring the CSS variables, `font-display` / `font-pixel` / `font-sans`

### Content
- `src/data/projects.ts`: single source of truth for projects: `apps` (main quests), `sideStory` (Beats & Backlog), `sites` (quest log). Each entry has status, blurb, longer description, meta, image and links
- `public/projects/`: app store feature graphics (`*.png`, 1024x500) and live-site screenshots (`*.jpg`, 16:10)

### Shared components
- `src/components/Panel.tsx`: comic panel box (plain / tone / speed / ink)
- `src/components/StatusTag.tsx`: status label colored by tone
- `src/components/QuestCard.tsx`: app card with store graphic
- `src/components/QuestLogRow.tsx`: site row with screenshot
- `src/components/SectionHeading.tsx`: display heading with pixel note and ink rule

### Pages (all static)
- `src/app/page.tsx`: Home: speed-line hero panels, Main Quests, Beats & Backlog side story, Quest Log, CONTINUE? call to action
- `src/app/projects/page.tsx`: Quest Log: every app and site with its longer write-up
- `src/app/about/page.tsx`: Player profile: portrait, bio, stats, save-history job timeline
- `src/app/contact/page.tsx`: CONTINUE? option menu (book a call, email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Medium)

## Common Tasks

**To run locally:** `npm install && npm run dev` (http://localhost:3000), or start the `dev` config in `.claude/launch.json`
**To build:** `npm run build && npm start`
**To lint:** `npm run lint`
**To change colors:** edit both `src/app/globals.css` (CSS vars) and `tailwind.config.ts` (theme colors); they must stay in sync.
**To add or change a project:** edit `src/data/projects.ts` and drop the image in `public/projects/`. Home and Projects update together. Use the project's own README or site for copy.

## Environment Variables

- None currently consumed by the codebase.
